verdict.rationale: There is no explicit 'export everything and leave' feature, but several pieces support portability. Telemetry can be exported as OpenTelemetry (OTLP) metrics and analyzed in any OpenTelemetry tool. Logs use a standardized, documented format and are written to local files. kongctl manages resources declaratively as code, and a Konnect API lists AI Gateway entities. Together these point toward open-format extraction of configuration and observability data. Missing for 10: a documented full-data/account export path, an explicit declarative config export/dump workflow, export of Konnect-hosted analytics history, and independent or hands-on confirmation that migrating away works.
